security_spec.violation_condition: XiangShan vector load/store unit writes active destination vector register elements past the element index where a synchronous trap (e.g., page fault, access fault) is reported, when VECTOR_LOAD_PAST_TRAP=false in the configuration. Specifically, if the vector LSU pipeline continues to retire store data into vregs for indices beyond the faulting element before the trap is taken, or if fault-only-first (FF) segment loads overwrite destination elements beyond the vl-trim point when VECTOR_LOAD_SEG_FF_OVERWRITE_ELEMENTS_AFTER_FAULT="no_overwrite", the hardware corrupts architectural state that software believes is preserved across the trap boundary.
security_spec.vulnerability_pattern: vector LSU trap handling, vreg writeback past trap index, FF segment load partial writeback, vs1/vs2/vd register file update beyond vl after exception, vectored memory access fault index tracking in LSU pipe stage, vstart/vl mismatch after trap return
security_spec.summary: Implementation-defined vector trap-adjacent writeback behaviors (VECTOR_LOAD_PAST_TRAP, VECTOR_FF_UPDATE_PAST_TRIM, VECTOR_LS_SEG_PARTIAL_ACCESS, VECTOR_LOAD_SEG_FF_OVERWRITE_ELEMENTS_AFTER_FAULT) must exactly match XiangShan LSU/PTW trap sequencing: if RTL writes vreg elements beyond the trap index while config declares no such writes, software-visible architectural state will be corrupted after trap return
